The test expects punctuation dropped and whitespace collapsed; the implementation just lowercases and replaces each
space with a dash. Fixing slugify:
/// Turns a title into a URL slug: lowercase words joined by dashes.
+ /// Non-alphanumeric characters are dropped, runs of whitespace become a
+ /// single dash, and leading/trailing separators are trimmed.
slugify only lowercased and swapped spaces for dashes, so "Hello, World!" produced "hello,--world!" —
punctuation kept, double space doubled up.
(src/lib.rs): lowercase → replace every non-alphanumeric char with a space → split on whitespace → join with -.
That drops punctuation, collapses runs of whitespace, and trims leading/trailing separators.
